resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1970 Texas Forest News article describes the Henderson County towers as still to be erected when it was written; the Register dates the Chandler tower to 1970. These are consistent with a 1970 build, and the exact month is not given.

notes_for_editor: Thin on current condition and access: the newest evidence is the March 2019 Register drone photos and video, and the FFLA list (undated) marks it Standing. The 1970 Texas Forest News scan is OCR text with broken word spacing, so quotes are copied as printed. The article places the planned tower about four miles northwest of Chandler; a Facebook post seen only as a search snippet (not opened, fetch returned a login page) gives six miles and a November 1970 dedication. That snippet was not used or cited. Register coordinates (32.340344, -95.528777) were not checked against Chandler's town centre. Access, staffing after 1970 and the Texas Forest Service's current role for this tower are unknown; a Texas Forest Service or Texas Historical Commission check would help.
